target: CopyOnWriteList<T>.GetEnumerator and the concrete-foreach pattern claim only.

originalFinding.summary: The concrete collection exposes only an interface-returning GetEnumerator.
originalFinding.explanation: A foreach over CopyOnWriteList<T> binds to this public GetEnumerator, whose IEnumerator<T> return type forces an interface enumerator and prevents an allocation-free concrete struct-enumerator path.

actualProductionFitGate: Before selecting a struct-enumerator implementation, establish a real shipping caller using the concrete pattern. ControllerContext and PageContext expose IList<IValueProviderFactory>; an interface consumer cannot select a new concrete struct pattern.
actualBoundedReachabilityAudit: Inspect the actual loaded MVC cohort and each decoded IL call/newobj operand, distinguishing concrete GetEnumerator calls, non-generic forwarding, constructor sites and public property types. This is not a whole-repository or arbitrary dynamic/external caller absence proof.
actualConditionalDisposition: If no non-forwarding concrete consumer is established in the inspected producer/consumer cohort, retain shipping source byte-for-byte, document original real-interface enumeration with a baseline-only BDN profile, and reject the concrete-only optimization for lack of demonstrated production fit. Do not invent a caller or claim every possible redesign is impossible.
actualNotPublicApiCompatibilityRejection: The enclosing type is internal; do not misclassify this as the public ValidationStateDictionary API constraint from F105.
actualTimedBoundary: Actual HTTP-produced collection; full generic/nongeneric interface enumeration consumes every reference into an order-sensitive identity checksum. Retained-enumerator return separately exposes escape behavior. IndexOf is an unchanged same-collection diagnostic. HTTP, source creation, first write, reflection, metadata inspection and checksum validation stay outside timing.
actualProducer: Real TestServer MVC controller activation with both EnableActionInvokers modes, no ValueProviderFactories property substitution. Public Add/RemoveAt creates the private copy and a second real request proves source/request isolation. Prepare asynchronously before synchronous GlobalSetup.
actualCorrectnessRequirements: Ordered references, null entries, generic/nongeneric parity and copy-on-write source isolation.
Cursor/Reset/nongeneric Current behavior on actual array-backed and copied stores.
An enumerator captured before the first write retains the old store; an already-copied list enumerator detects later mutation.
Arbitrary supplied IReadOnlyList is enumerated without Count/indexer assumptions; existing public interface identity and eager forwarding are preserved.
Early loop exit or consumer failure disposes the actual returned source enumerator.
Each selected XML row must really execute and pass without a skip; preservation tests are not semantic bug-fix red/green evidence.
actualBaselineOnlyNumericClaim: Report absolute original observations, not before/after improvements; no fabricated candidate, ratio or source comparison.
machine: Shared non-isolated Windows box. Serialize builds and timing, max two MSBuild workers; no priority, affinity, power, firewall, URL ACL or OS setting changes.
publication: Fork-only connected evidence and an honest tracking disposition. No performance PR or Edge launch without a justified improvement. Advance only F122 after remote receipt verification; fixed REPORT unchanged; continue the standing campaign.
